name: Lebanese Lemon Garlic Chicken and Potato Traybake

components.name: Chicken and Potato Traybake

ingredients.name: Raw bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Dry raw chicken with paper towels and pat potatoes dry for browning.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, seven-spice, paprika, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Arrange chicken and halved potatoes in a large baking pan, then coat thoroughly with the lemon-garlic mixture.
Roast uncovered for 55-65 minutes. Check potatoes are tender and every chicken portion is at least 74 C at the thickest part.
Rest 5 minutes, then garnish with measured parsley. Divide cooked potato and edible chicken across four containers; bones should be discarded before accurate yield weighing.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Directly based on the published one-pan chicken and potatoes. Raw bone-in chicken weight is not the edible nutrition weight.
Planning: This differs from Greek lemon chicken by its Lebanese seven-spice seasoning.
Freezer: potato texture may soften after freezing
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
